Starship Flight 14 reached orbit and deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites—but an engine shutdown prompted SpaceX to bring Ship 41 home early. We break down the orbital milestone, both splashdowns, and what the mission could mean for Flight 15.

Join NSF’s Ryan Caton for a closer look at Booster 21’s engine performance, its simulated catch maneuver, and the planned flight termination system demonstration after splashdown. We also examine Ship 41’s orbital insertion, satellite deployment, early deorbit, and first reentry from orbit.

Then, we look ahead to Booster 22 and Ship 42, possible catches on Flight 15, Pad 2 improvements, and preparations for Starship launches from Florida’s Launch Complex 39A. Plus, updates on the transport barge You’ll Thank Me Later and Ship 40’s return.

Will
title: Starship Flight 14 Reaches Orbit—but Returns Early | Starship Update
